virality_data.topic: Teaching Claude to stop generating 2019 JavaScript using modern web guidance rules
virality_data.analysis: AI coding assistants hallucinate obsolete 2019 JS patterns like polyfills, bulky fetch wrappers, and outdated canvas loops instead of modern Web APIs. Google Chrome's release of 'modern-web-guidance' shot straight to the top of Hacker News with 367 points and over 100 passionate comments this week. Positioning this as a direct Cursor/Claude prompt and system config injection turns an abstract GitHub spec into an instant, copy-paste workflow upgrade for frontend devs.
cross_source_signals: Hacker News: 367 points, 108 comments on GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance
Reddit r/webdev: Repeated complaints about LLMs writing legacy bundling and obsolete DOM APIs
virality_data.story_angle: I spent two hours deleting unnecessary Babel dependencies and polyfills that Claude 3.5 Sonnet generated for a simple modern client app until I discovered Google Chrome's modern web primitives guide.
virality_data.suman_angle: Stop Vibe Coding Like It's 2019: How I Updated Claude's JavaScript Memory in 15 Minutes
virality_data.competing_articles: Most Cursor/Claude setup articles focus on general markdown rules; this is the first deep dive into modern native browser primitives (Web Streams, native Dialog, CSS nesting) preventing bloated AI output.

virality_data.topic: Zero-backend browser audio synthesis with the Web Audio API
virality_data.analysis: Solo projects that deliver tactile, delightful interactions purely in the browser without backends or complex audio engines consistently trend at the top of Hacker News. Guitoro generated 573 points and 161 comments by showing how far native browser audio capabilities have come with clever keyboard-to-frequency mappings. Medium builders respond strongly to realistic teardowns showing how to manage low-latency audio sample loading and key-event debouncing in lightweight vanilla JavaScript.
cross_source_signals: Hacker News: 573 points, 161 comments on Guitoro virtual guitar launch
Reddit r/javascript: Growing interest in zero-framework native Web Audio projects
GitHub: Web Audio synthesizer and sampler repos trending in creative coding tags
virality_data.story_angle: After struggling with latency and complex external frameworks for a browser project, I decided to build a playable instrument using zero dependencies and pure Web Audio buffers.
virality_data.suman_angle: How to Build a Zero-Latency Virtual Instrument in Vanilla JavaScript (No External Audio Libraries)
virality_data.competing_articles: Most Web Audio tutorials rely on heavy abstractions like Tone.js or Howler; this breaks down raw AudioContext buffers, gain nodes, and event-driven multi-touch strumming directly.
